never_permitted: Stage 19 results are directly numerically comparable with the Stage-15/16 per-flow benchmark.
Multi-scale temporal context causally explains any performance difference.
The final holdout was used for model, threshold or preprocessing selection.
Stage 19 modifies or supersedes the frozen Stage 18 feasibility conclusions.
permitted_if_supported_by_results: MTemporal-IDS captures authentic causal multi-scale temporal context.
MTemporal-IDS demonstrates chronological second-bin intrusion-detection performance.
MTemporal-IDS ranking or thresholded performance differs descriptively from the frozen single-scale temporal control.

model_naming_boundary: MTemporal-IDS is the explicit architecture defined by this protocol. The study does not claim reproduction of a universally canonical architecture named MTemporal Transformer.

mtemporal_model.long_name: Multi-Scale Temporal Transformer for Intrusion Detection
mtemporal_model.name: MTemporal-IDS

next_authorized_step: Stage 19.1 — raw source schema, timestamp, feature-intersection and chronology audit. TRAIN and VALIDATION may be materialized; HOLDOUT labels/predictors remain closed.

preprocessing.aggregation_missing_policy: Per-bin feature means computed from finite observations only.
preprocessing.imputation: TRAIN aggregated-feature mean; no validation or holdout statistics used.
preprocessing.nonfinite_policy: Flow-level +/-inf converted to NaN before aggregation.
preprocessing.normalization: StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN bins only

research_question: Can a strictly causal multi-scale temporal Transformer detect second-level intrusion activity under a fully chronological CSE-CIC-IDS2018 protocol?

single_scale_control.name: SingleScaleTemporalTransformer
single_scale_control.purpose: Paired temporal control for assessing whether multi-scale context provides descriptive benefit.
single_scale_control.reason: Parameterization and architecture differ after multi-scale fusion, so comparison is descriptive.

task.comparison_with_flow_level_benchmark: NOT_DIRECTLY_COMPARABLE because Stage 19 predicts second-level attack presence rather than per-flow binary labels.
task.prediction_interpretation: Detection after completion of the current one-second traffic interval.
task.target_definition: A one-second bin is positive if one or more source flows assigned to that second carry a non-BENIGN label; otherwise it is negative.

temporal_representation.empty_bin_policy: Numeric aggregate predictors are missing before train-only preprocessing. They are imputed using TRAIN aggregated-feature means so an empty bin maps to zero after standardization. Occupancy remains explicitly 0.
temporal_representation.positional_encoding: Deterministic relative temporal position encoding within each scale.
temporal_representation.source_predictor_policy: Use the common numeric CICFlowMeter predictor intersection established during Stage 19.1 source audit; identifiers, labels and timestamps are excluded from predictors.
temporal_representation.warmup_policy: The first 20 minutes of each source day are excluded deterministically before labels are examined.
temporal_representation.window_endpoint: All three scales terminate at the current prediction second.
